notes.title: Ver. 0.8.3 Update!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32928405/6fe071a9cc3d5f5d77b870e652b2932210abd002.png

Hey guys! There's another update for you! :)
- New interesting tube-shaped things i recomend to investigate (and die a few times after that ;)
- Now you will be even more comfortable with your x360 controller (don't have to switch it on in settings menu)
- Better low-on-health and low-on-ammo indications
- Vsync turned back on ;)

Keep doing your playthrough videos and write your reviews at Steam Page - I SEE EVERYTHING!!! ;)
